title: Shared materials key table
description: One row per phase, where a phase is (formula, cell setting). This is the join key the property tables share. It is DERIVED from the property tables plus Materials Project identifiers, so it declares no source_key of its own; provenance lives in the property tables. The Materials Project id here is an IDENTIFIER ONLY - no MP value is used as reference data in this collection.

materials_project_id.description: Join key only. Empty where no MP entry matched on (formula, space group); never guessed.
